history_summary: Ground six Sahara collection reference descriptors while retaining all Paenibacillus alternatives and scientific limitations.
history_details: The native crosswalk adds six reference blocks and statuses at indices 0,1,2,3,4,6, plus two native events. Halobacillus trueperi maps by exact species ID to a Halobacillus aidingensis reference majority with total_genomes 7 and fraction 0.86; no support numerator is inferred from the rounded fraction and no study isolate is reidentified. The five genus reference populations are Bacillus 4981/8737 at 0.57, Virgibacillus 91/150 at 0.607, Oceanobacillus 107/129 at 0.829, Gracilibacillus 64/64 and Pontibacillus 23/29 at 0.793. These filtered populations are not source isolate frequencies, environmental abundance, salinity tolerance or ecological roles. Native status traversal processes seven descriptors but only six change; existing Paenibacillus index 5 and all 33 ordered ambiguity alternatives remain unchanged. Preserve the source H. trueperi name, seven broad descriptors, unknown strain identities and complete biological content, quotations and old history. The retained abstract describes 336 isolates across five sites, a dominant ITS subset of 42 isolates and 14 BOX-PCR genotypes; it does not establish a seven-strain SynCom or a stock-genome mapping. Preserve measured growth classes, marker diversity and the qualified marine-origin suggestion. Geographic correlation does not establish causal salinity adaptation. Captured OPEN issue 2924 retains the causal-geography, collection interpretation and PRIMARY_DEGRADER role concerns; this taxonomy-only correction neither endorses nor repairs those claims. Keep the original batch 135 ledger and every current biological predicate, and compose existing 491/492 admissions only after complete saved-input capture. The exact crosswalk bytes have an unestablished release; NCBI authority is observed by file identity/stat, not a whole-database digest. This partial technical correction claims no full-paper scientific review, new acquisition, measured references, generated products or full QC.
